mapper.sql: l.id, l.student_id, l.category, l.start_date, l.end_date, l.days, l.reason, l.status, l.counselor_id, l.approve_time, l.create_time
mapper.select: SELECT , s.name AS student_name, s.student_no AS student_no, u.real_name AS counselor_name FROM student_record l LEFT JOIN student s ON l.student_id = s.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON l.counselor_id = u.id WHERE l.record_type = 'LEAVE' AND l.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student_record (record_type, student_id, category, start_date, end_date, days, reason, status, counselor_id) VALUES ('LEAVE', #{studentId}, #{leaveType}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{days}, #{reason}, #{status}, #{counselorId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM student_record WHERE record_type = 'LEAVE' AND id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM student_record WHERE record_type = 'LEAVE' AND status = #{status}
